title: Arrow Pop 3D
tagline: Tap arrows in the right order to escape every tile
description: Arrow Pop 3D is a chunky cartoon-styled 3D logic puzzle. Each level fills the board with colorful arrow tiles facing different directions. Tap an arrow and it shoots out of the board — but only if its path to the boundary is clear. The challenge is finding the exact tap order: every arrow blocked by another won't move, so you must unlock the right starting tile and let a satisfying chain reaction unwind the whole pattern. Featuring 10 hand-crafted shape levels (heart, spiral, star, diamond and more) plus 30 procedurally generated boards with guaranteed solvability, vibrant primary colors, juicy particle bursts, screen shake, procedural Web Audio music and SFX. Designed for adults during short breaks: one level lasts 1–3 minutes, plays beautifully on portrait mobile, installs as a PWA on your home screen, and never wastes your time with forced ads. Find the seed arrow, watch the spiral unravel.

controls.en: Tap an arrow to shoot it off the board. Arrows blocked by others won't move — find the right order.
controls.ja: 矢印をタップしてその向きに発射。進路を塞がれた矢印は動かない。順番を見極めよう。
